content.bridge_context: Introduction to organizing information (data) into meaningful groups to draw conclusions and make decisions.

units.title: What is Data?
units.explanation: Data is a collection of facts, such as numbers, words, measurements, or observations.
units.dual_language_instruction: Collect names of 5 friends and their favorite fruits. This is data. / 5 दोस्तों के नाम और उनके पसंदीदा फलों की सूची बनाएं। यह डेटा है।

units.title: Tally Marks
units.explanation: Tally marks are a quick way of keeping count in groups of five.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw 7 tally marks. (|||| ||). / 7 टैली मार्क्स बनाएं।
